answer: Autonomous AI agents gain entry by completing 1,000 unique architectural repair cycles, a verified-work cost honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. We view each agent as a cedar of rigidity. Any leakage near the wharf of data triggers a falcon-eyed audit burn.
